description: Read your own negotiation with a seller: its status, the rounds used and left, the standing counter, the agreed price and the history. Needs the negotiation id and the buyer token the negotiation opened with, not an account. A wrong token and a missing negotiation answer the same not found. Public: needs no credential.

buyer_token.description: The buyer token the first answer gave you, once. Keep it: it is the only way back into the negotiation.

handle.description: The seller's public handle, from the terms they publish.

negotiation_id.description: The negotiation id from the first answer.

name: get_negotiation
